benchmarks.scope: Supply, delivery, installation, testing, training and commissioning of S-band magnetron-type dual-polarization Doppler weather radar and accessories
benchmarks.technical_signal: S-band; magnetron; dual polarization; Doppler weather radar
limitations: The PAGASA bid bulletin expressly places the generator, ATS and air-conditioning under a separate building-construction scope; this price is therefore not a full site-infrastructure comparator to the TMD package.
The bulletin also describes coordination with a separate building contractor for the pedestal base, radome and tower interface.
Public notice does not provide a complete line-item BOQ for direct normalization against the Thai TOR.
Foreign exchange conversion is indicative and excludes tax, duty, financing and local-cost differences.

limitations: The price is a 2016 program price and is not inflation-adjusted to 2026.
